## Highlights

- Added saved overlay profiles so stream layouts can be switched, saved, and saved as new presets from the Overlay settings workspace
- Added visual color pickers across overlay styling, including fixed-position popovers that stay visible inside the settings window
- Refreshed the desktop shell and settings UI around the Starsong design direction, including updated TideReader branding and tighter control alignment

## Overlay customization

- Added profile persistence to settings with automatic migration from existing overlay styling into a default profile
- Added Save and Save As profile actions for the active overlay setup
- Added color swatches and manual hex inputs for text, background, gradient, border, and status-pill colors
- Improved invalid color handling so bad manual edits are surfaced locally without overwriting the last valid saved color
- Cleaned up border controls and profile toolbar spacing so dense overlay settings read more consistently

## Desktop and development polish

- Updated the TideReader application icon and compact shell branding
- Added `TIDEREADER_KEEP_WINDOW_VISIBLE=1` for desktop UI development so close and minimize actions do not hide the app to the tray
- Documented the desktop visibility flag and the new overlay profile/color customization capabilities
- Expanded frontend and backend test coverage for overlay profile persistence, normalization, clone isolation, and color-picker interactions

## Notes

- This release is a minor version bump because it adds new overlay profile workflows and a broader visual customization surface
- Automated frontend coverage, backend coverage, dependency audit, release build, desktop publish, and release packaging checks are expected to pass for this release
